title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon International Seller Services
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about building software that operates at massive scale and directly impacts millions of sellers? As a Software Development Engineer II on the Seller Compliance team at Amazon, you will design, build, and deliver features that help solve complex regulatory challenges across Amazon's EU marketplace. You will own your work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer needs through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into clear, simple solutions, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing new feature development with refactoring and operational improvements to maintain a healthy and extensible codebase.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business and customer needs, ensuring the solutions you deliver are well-aligned with both technical and product requirements.
* Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the quality bar for the team and helping newer team members ramp up effectively.
* Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, contributing to your team's operational excellence and reducing recurring support costs.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches — including generative AI capabilities — to improve development workflows, and make recommendations for adoption that increase team productivity and code quality.

**About The Team**
The Unified Services for Selling Partners team builds the platform that powers third-party service discovery and purchase for Amazon sellers navigating complex regulatory and compliance requirements across global marketplaces. We own the E2E compliance services platform serving over 57,000 sellers across 786,000+ services. Our engineers work at the intersection of compliance, seller experience, and platform scalability, collaborating closely with product, policy, and program partners to translate evolving regulatory landscapes into seamless, scalable technical solutions. We are an inclusive, collaborative team where every engineer has a voice in shaping our technical direction and architectural decisions. If you want to build systems that operate at Amazon scale, solve real-world regulatory challenges for sellers worldwide, and help define the future of compliance technology, this is the place to be.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 2+ years of full stack development experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: SDE II - Backend, Cross Border Shopping Experience
description:
**Description**
Stay local, shop global! Amazon Cross Border Shopping experiences allow customers to easily discover a wide selection of international products available from Amazon’s websites around the world, offering simplified customs, faster delivery, local language and payment support, and a world-class customer service. Global Store and Customer Exports have presence in multiple countries and is at the forefront of Amazon’s global expansion strategy. We have maintained a startup culture and are looking for a Software Development Engineer I with an entrepreneurial mindset and tech prowess to solve the next level of challenges in international shopping for worldwide customers.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer (SDE) to join the Cross Border Customer Experience team. In this role, the SDE will design, write, and maintain user experience software for Amazon shopping pages used by millions of customers around the world. The engineer will collaborate with world-class product managers to define the future direction of customer experience throughout the entire shopping journey (Search, Detail Page, All Offers Display, Cart, Checkout, Order Details Page) and will apply the best engineering practices to deliver working solutions for international Amazon customers. The SDE will work on customer’s international shopping journey including personalized recommendations and displaying relevant cross-border shopping information (pricing, delivery, legal) in order to enable customers to shop efficiently and with confidence while delivering on business goals. The SDE will adhere to best practices of software development in large-scale distributed systems while innovating and experimenting in an agile fashion. You will participate in the entire software lifecycle from concept, design, development, through testing, release, and maintenance. You will be mentored by tenured Amazon engineers and you will be expected to coach and mentor others around you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Gather and analyze business and functional requirements, and translate business requirements into technical design specifications.
* Write high-quality, efficient, testable code and recommend improvements in development, maintenance, and system standards, and contribute to software documentation.
* Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions
* Maintain and support our software in production including urgent support for customer-facing systems
* Be responsible for technical problem solving, meeting product objectives, and developing best practices
* Serve as an essential technical resource in the full development cycle.
* Mentor junior team members technically
* Contribute to multi-year product and technical roadmaps

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Lineaje
is building the trusted foundation for secure software and secure AI.

We help organizations discover, secure, govern, and continuously verify software, open source, and AI across the entire application lifecycle.

Lineaje
provides Continuous Software Supply Chain Security Management to companies that build or use software. Destructive supply chain attacks, often undetectable by existing cybersecurity tools, are growing dramatically and can impact thousands of companies with a single compromise. From SolarWinds to Kaseya to OSS compromises, these attacks put software & digital brands and their customers at risk. Lineaje secures your Company from these attacks

**Our Opportunity**

We are a fast-growing company looking to hire Forward Deployed Engineers.

If you are interested in joining this category, review the requirements below and send us your resume.

**Role Description**

The Forward Deployed Engineer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Bengaluru. In this role, the engineer works directly with customers to understand their software supply chain security needs, design tailored solutions, and deploy Lineaje’s products into complex enterprise environments. The engineer serves as the primary technical lead through onboarding, POCs, and pilots, troubleshooting issues in live environments and translating customer requirements into actionable product feedback.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Partner with customers to deploy and configure solutions (cloud/on-prem) tailored to their needs.
2. Act as the technical lead during onboarding, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and pilot engagements.
3. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to translate customer requirements into product features or configurations.
4. Troubleshoot technical issues in live environments and provide rapid, effective solutions.
5. Build reusable deployment playbooks, automation scripts, and integrations.
6. Read, debug, and modify product or integration code to resolve field-blocking issues or accelerate customer onboarding.
7. Build and maintain customer-specific integrations with CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories (JFrog Artifactory, Nexus), and developer toolchains.
8. Deliver technical training and documentation to customer teams.
9. Serve as the voice of the customer, providing feedback to internal teams to shape the roadmap.
10. Travel up to 25% of time to customer sites for deployment or technical workshops.

**Qualifications - Required Skills:**

1. Strong background in software engineering or systems engineering.
2. Proficiency in one or more of Java, Python, or JavaScript/npm, with the ability to read, debug, and modify code across these ecosystems as needed in customer environments.
3. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes).
4. Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and scripting (Python, Bash, or similar).
5. Familiarity with networking, security concepts, and enterprise IT environments.
6. Ability to quickly understand complex systems and design scalable solutions.
7. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and customer-facing skills.
8. Experience with cybersecurity products (SBOM, SIEM, IAM, DLP, CASB, etc.).
9. Experience with software supply chain security concepts (SBOM, SCA, vulnerability management, VEX)
10. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, or other automation tools.
11. Prior experience in customer-facing technical roles (Forward Deployment Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, etc.).
